text: Question: I can't log in to the My NovaTel app — it says 'OTP not received'. Answer: ### Short Answer Ensure the registered SIM has network signal and isn't blocking service SMS. Try 'Resend OTP' after 30 seconds, or use the 'Login via Missed Call' alternative if enabled. Persistent failures may indicate an SMS-delivery issue with your handset's spam filter. ### Detailed Explanation The suggested order moves from most to least likely cause: signal/SMS-blocking issues first (since OTP is delivered by SMS), then a simple resend, then an alternative login method that doesn't depend on SMS at all, with a persistent-failure note pointing at the handset's own spam filter as a less obvious but real cause. ### Key Details | Detail | Value | |---|---| | Check first | Registered SIM has network signal and isn't blocking service SMS | | Retry option | 'Resend OTP' after 30 seconds | | Alternative login | 'Login via Missed Call', if enabled | | If persistent | May indicate handset's own SMS spam filter is blocking it | ### Troubleshooting | Symptom | Possible Cause | Diagnostic Check | Recommended Action | |---|---|---|---| | OTP not received, first attempt | Weak signal or service SMS temporarily blocked | Network signal strength on the registered SIM | Confirm signal, then use Resend OTP after 30 seconds | | OTP still not received after resend | SMS not reaching the device despite normal signal | Whether Login via Missed Call is enabled as an
title: I can't log in to the My NovaTel app — it says 'OTP not received'.
